    Bootstrap the Minimal FREM Model (Phase 1)

    createFREMmodel_phase1.Rd

    This is the internal bootstrapper function for the FREM generation pipeline. It reads the base NONMEM model and the Full Fixed Effects Model (FFEM) dataset, processes strictly the first covariate from the provided list, and generates a minimal FREM data file, .mod file, and a mock .ext file. It inherently handles dynamic Y-1 categorical expansions (e.g., splitting a 3-level categorical variable into two dummy variables) and establishes the initial FREMTYPE sequencing.

    Usage

    createFREMmodel_phase1(
  runno = NULL,
  modName = NULL,
  modDevDir = NULL,
  ffemDataFile,
  covariates,
  outputDir = NULL,
  minModName = "minimal_model",
  keepMinimalModel = FALSE,
  cstrKeepCols = c("ID", "TIME", "AMT", "II", "EVID", "SS", "RATE"),
  numSkipOm = 0,
  IDvar = "ID",
  missVal = -99,
  fixTheta = TRUE,
  roundMeanTo = 1,
  catCovs = NULL,
  logtCovs = NULL,
  useMuModeling = TRUE,
  bRecodeDichotomous = FALSE,
  allowNon01 = FALSE,
  keepDoseOnlySubjects = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    runno

    Standard PMX run number.

    modName

    Standard PMX model name.

    modDevDir

    Standard PMX model development directory.

    ffemDataFile

    Character. Path to the base FFEM dataset.

    covariates

    Character vector. The full list of covariates to be added to the FREM model. Phase 1 strictly processes the first element.

    outputDir

    Character. Directory where the minimal files will be saved. Defaults to modDevDir or current working directory.

    minModName

    Character. The base name for the generated minimal files. Defaults to "minimal_model".

    keepMinimalModel

    Logical. Should the minimal files be retained after the full pipeline completes? Passed back to the master wrapper. Defaults to FALSE.

    cstrKeepCols

    Character vector. Columns to strictly retain in the generated FREM dataset.

    numSkipOm

    Numeric. Number of initial OMEGA parameters to skip when appending new FREM parameters. Defaults to 0.

    IDvar

    Character. The name of the subject identifier column. Defaults to "ID".

    missVal

    Numeric. The value representing missing data in the covariates. Defaults to -99.

    fixTheta

    Logical. Should the initial THETA estimates for the covariates be fixed? Defaults to TRUE.

    roundMeanTo

    Numeric. The number of decimal places to round the calculated baseline covariate means. Defaults to 1.

    catCovs

    Character vector. Names of the covariates that should be treated as categorical.

    logtCovs

    Character vector. Names of continuous covariates that should be log-transformed.

    useMuModeling

    Logical. Should MU-referencing be utilized when generating the NONMEM $PK and $ERROR blocks? Defaults to TRUE.

    bRecodeDichotomous

    Logical. Should dichotomous covariates be automatically recoded to 0/1? Defaults to FALSE. If FALSE, inputs must be strictly 0/1.

    allowNon01

    Logical. If TRUE, allows non-0/1 dichotomous covariates (like 1/2) to pass through untouched for PsN compatibility. Defaults to FALSE.

    keepDoseOnlySubjects

    Logical. If FALSE (default), subjects without any valid PK observations (e.g., only dosing records) are completely excluded from the generated dataset. If TRUE, these subjects are retained and their covariates are included as observations.

    quiet

    Logical. Should the function execute silently without console messages? Defaults to FALSE.

    ...

    Additional arguments passed down to internal helper functions (e.g., createFREMData, prepareAndValidateData).

    Value

    An invisible list containing:

    • minimalModelFile: Path to the generated minimal .mod file.

    • minimalDataFile: Path to the generated minimal .csv data file.

    • mockExtFile: Path to the generated mock .ext file.

    • keepMinimalModel: Boolean flag passed back to the master wrapper for cleanup logic.

    • validatedData: The filtered and validated FFEM dataset as a data.frame.

    See also

    createFREMmodel, updateFREMmodel

    Other FREM model management Internal: createMinimalFremModel(), generateFremModel(), initializeModelParameters(), removeFremCovariates()
